meta.title: Fresh Green Skin
meta.description: Fresh white-green skin: photo or video wallpaper, auto contrast scrim, five system papers
meta.detail: Upload a photo or a video as the wallpaper: the scrim and the ink follow the picture's brightness, so text stays readable on any backdrop. Comes with five system papers, five colour anchors, a fully see-through sidebar, one-click presets, theme import/export, a custom logo, a quick-launch chip dock, font choice and shortcut-switched themes.
